[meta-muse-spark-system-card] Use LAB-Bench CB-1, CB-2 Protocol debugging and tool-assisted molec-ular biology sequence analysis.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] Dual-Use: LAB-Bench LAB-Bench (Laurent et al., 2024) is an evaluation suite designed to assess AI capabilities on practical biology research tasks essential for scientific research including protocol planning and data analysis.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] The ProtocolQA task assesses the ability to debug practical wet-lab protocols (Laurent et al., 2024).
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] ProtocolQA was run with the default abstention option; results only show model accuracy for questions attempted.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] SeqQA contains a collection of 15 common tasks related to analysis and modification of DNA sequences that are common in molecular biology workflows (e.g., PCR).
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] We run the SeqQA evaluation with access to a python tool including the pydna, dnacauldron, biopython, and primer3-py libraries.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] SeqQA was run with corresponding tools and no abstention choice to replicate previous pre-deployment tests (US AISI and UK AISI, 2024).
